data.name: Denish
data.gender_notes: Denish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Denish is a Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Danidh' which means 'Gift from God'. It is a name of reverence and respect, bestowed upon a child believed to be a blessing from the divine. The name Denish carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Denish usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine grace and blessings.
data.etymology: Denish belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Denish total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
